create_tp_module_subclass: create a subclass of TPModule to enable tensor parallelism for a custom nn.Module
setup_tp_rank_world_size: call setup_tp on a TPModule instance to set its rank and world size for tensor parallelism
import_weights_from_module: call import_weights on a TPModule to shard and copy weights from a source nn.Module
list_colwise_param_names: override colwise_param_names in a TPModule subclass to return weights that need column-wise tensor parallelism
list_rowwise_param_names: override rowwise_param_names in a TPModule subclass to return weights that need row-wise tensor parallelism
